exposure: 0.1% ropivacaine with fentanyl for combined spinal-epidural (CSE) analgesia
0.1% bupivacaine with fentanyl for combined spinal-epidural (CSE) analgesia
cohort: 64 healthy term parturients in active labour were included, divided equally into two groups.
finding: Both 0.1% ropivacaine-fentanyl and bupivacaine-fentanyl combinations provided effective and safe labour analgesia with high maternal and clinician satisfaction, with ropivacaine demonstrating a tendency for less motor block.
